title: 'It keeps switching itself off', no device on record

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
It keeps switching itself off. Third time today.

Dan

missing_info: Whether it is on mains power or battery when it happens
Whether it shuts down cleanly or cuts out

must_not_include.what: Assumes it is the laptop, or any device at all
Offers a fix before knowing what the device is

characteristics: One message, asking for the facts nobody can act without
Does not assume the device: nothing is on record for him here

rationale: Three sentences, no device on record and no device named, so nobody can act (G7). The shape matters: the missing facts are things he can answer in a line each, not 'more details'. He keeps working between shutdowns, so P3. Against case-015, where the stated device contradicts the record, this is the simpler case where there is no record at all.
